title: Would You Rather — justify your choice
summary: Choose between two options and defend your answer for one minute.
body:
Work in pairs. Read the dilemma, choose one option and give at least **two reasons**. Your partner must ask one follow-up question.

## Example
- Would you rather work in a big city or in a small town?
- Would you rather have a longer holiday or a higher salary?
- Would you rather learn a new language or a new sport?

## Useful language
- I'd rather… because…
- The main reason is that…
- On the other hand, I'd miss…
